subject: [PATCH 6/6] mm/hwpoison-inject: keep the page online while filtering it

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the hwpoison-inject module where injecting a memory error while filtering it and the memory is hot-removed can cause a crash. The issue occurs because the filter can sleep, causing the page to be offline when the memory is removed. To fix this, the patch adds a lock around the filter check using get_online_mems() and checks if the pfn is valid under this lock. This ensures that the page remains online while filtering it, preventing the crash.
